hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$' && ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?|jsx?|css)$' && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(\.env|uv\.lock|secrets)' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env\.example$' && echo 'BLOCK: Protected file' && exit 2 || exit 0
